description: #276, the check that the interlock takes effect: the ET42 of et42_td_converter_interlock_cold, with ConverterStartDelay=60 added to both sections, so the converters need a minute to start. With LineContactorsInterlock=Converter the line contactors wait for them and the train leaves later than it does with the same converter delay and no interlock (20 km/h at 80.0 s with it, at 73.8 s without it, measured with this case and a copy without the interlock key). Then it runs the timetable to Przystanek.
